title: Fixed Horizontal Grater Drum and Open Hopper Coffee Pulper
description: One newly authored whole fixed horizontal-drum hand coffee-pulper-inspired machine. Four complete ground legs, full rails and two full bearing side plates carry a long transverse shaft, one entire blunt relief-pattern drum, an actual open rectangular tapered hopper and a separate curved breastplate. A large complete open six-spoke side handwheel, full crank pin and wooden grip form the visible drive organization. A full front descending open chute and separate full rear descending open chute have continuous floors and sidewalls; both are empty static outfalls without a continuous processing-path claim. The full drum relief is integrated into one closed surface, not scattered teeth or a copied grinder face. No existing sheller casting, disc, chaff trough, swept cutter, coffee-roaster barrel or cooling pan imported. The horizontal full-width textured cylinder under a transverse open hopper and side wheel is structurally different from the compact single offset cob throat and vertical solid disc of the corn sheller, long trough and swept wheel blades of the chaff cutter, and deep closed barrel plus front cooling pan of the roaster. One whole model zero scenes. Original fictional proportions inspired only by the general hand drum-pulper class. No beans, pulp, water, food contact, processing separation, cylinder rotation, live clearance, hand operation instructions, power, throughput, manufacture, engineering, ergonomics or food-safety claim. Rigging animation physics and interaction not made.
